lines.zh: 地球这头的气候，比我想的暖。
lines.en: This side of Earth is warmer than I expected.

lines.zh: 我沿着回廊滑过去，脚下离地一寸。
lines.en: I slide down the gallery, an inch above the floor.

lines.zh: 我的球在这屋里滚得不太顺。
lines.en: My sphere doesn't roll well in this house.

lines.zh: 去后院看看那口井。
lines.en: Off to the back yard to check that well.

lines.zh: 楼梯太陡，我宁愿飘上去。
lines.en: The stairs are steep; I'd rather drift up.

lines.zh: 我走过神龛前，先欠了欠身。
lines.en: Passing the shrine, I bow my head a little.

lines.zh: 这一路的地砖，花纹不一样。
lines.en: The tiles change pattern along this hall.

lines.zh: 我挪到窗下，那里凉快。
lines.en: I move under the window; it's cooler there.

lines.zh: 门轴响了一声，我停住听。
lines.en: The hinge creaks, and I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我从帘后出来，慢慢绕到正面。
lines.en: I come from behind the curtain and drift around front.

lines.zh: 客人在院子那头，我过去。
lines.en: The guest is across the yard. I'll go over.

lines.zh: 风把纸灯笼吹得直晃。
lines.en: The wind sets the paper lanterns swinging.

lines.zh: 我把托盘端平，走得很稳。
lines.en: I level the tray and keep my pace even.

lines.zh: 这具身体在地球上待得久了。
lines.en: This body has been on Earth a long while.

lines.zh: 我把念珠从腕上褪下来数。
lines.en: I slip the beads off my wrist and count them.

lines.zh: 这口井的水，味道比家乡硬。
lines.en: The well water here tastes harder than home.

lines.zh: 我盯着一缕香，看它断在哪。
lines.en: I watch a thread of incense and where it breaks.

lines.zh: 卦象乱了，我重排一次。
lines.en: The hexagram's muddled. I lay it out again.

lines.zh: 我咳嗽了两声，屋里太干。
lines.en: I cough twice. The room's too dry.

lines.zh: 案上的灯该添油了。
lines.en: The lamp on the desk needs oil.

lines.zh: 我把手指按在球面上，停住。
lines.en: I press my fingers to the sphere and hold still.

lines.zh: 外面有人在扫地，沙沙的。
lines.en: Someone's sweeping outside. Shh, shh.

lines.zh: 我这双鞋，走久了底就薄。
lines.en: These shoes wear thin after long walking.

lines.zh: 今天的天象，不太安分。
lines.en: The sky's omens are restless today.

lines.zh: 我把披风叠好，放在膝上。
lines.en: I fold my cape and lay it on my knees.

lines.zh: 老客人不来，新客人倒勤。
lines.en: Old guests stay away; new ones come often.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸茶杯，凉透了。
lines.en: I touch the cup. Stone cold.

lines.zh: 这地方的地气，比我想的杂。
lines.en: The earth's breath here is muddier than I thought.

lines.zh: 地球上的年轻人，都这么急吗？
lines.en: Are all the young ones on Earth this hurried?

lines.zh: 你先坐下，我慢慢跟你讲。
lines.en: Sit down first, and I'll tell you slowly.

lines.zh: 你身上的尘土，来自北边。
lines.en: The dust on you came from the north.

lines.zh: 我在等一个人，也许就是你。
lines.en: I've been waiting for someone. Perhaps you.

lines.zh: 你的手掌摊开，别握拳。
lines.en: Open your palm. Don't clench it.

lines.zh: 这一卦不收你钱，只收你一句话。
lines.en: No fee for this reading — just one honest sentence.

lines.zh: 你的过去比你的未来清楚。
lines.en: Your past is clearer than your future.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有药味。
lines.en: I smell medicine on you.

lines.zh: 这院子里的影子，你数过吗？
lines.en: Have you counted the shadows in this yard?

lines.zh: 你来找我，是有人指的路。
lines.en: Someone pointed you my way.

lines.zh: 看相要付钱，盯着我看也一样。
lines.en: Readings cost money, and so does staring.

lines.zh: 把手放在球上，别用力。
lines.en: Rest your hand on the sphere. Don't press.

lines.zh: 你的影子后面还有一层影子。
lines.en: There's a second shadow behind yours.

lines.zh: 我说话慢，你耐心点。
lines.en: I speak slowly. Be patient.

lines.zh: 这屋子里，你说的每句话我都记着。
lines.en: In this house I remember every word you say.

lines.zh: 你来得正好，茶刚沏。
lines.en: Good timing. The tea's just brewed.

lines.zh: 咳，这一下撞得我喘不上气。
lines.en: Cough — that knocked the wind out of me.

lines.zh: 我的袖子撕了道口子。
lines.en: A tear in my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你打一个老婆子，也不害臊。
lines.en: Striking an old woman. Have you no shame?

lines.zh: 我扶着案角，慢慢坐下。
lines.en: I brace on the desk corner and sit slowly.

lines.zh: 血渗进布料，颜色很深。
lines.en: Blood seeps into the cloth, dark.

lines.zh: 这卦我算漏了一步。
lines.en: I missed a step in that reading.

lines.zh: 我咳出一口血，擦掉了。
lines.en: I cough up blood and wipe it away.

lines.zh: 水晶球晃了晃，我的头也晃。
lines.en: The crystal rocks, and so does my head.

lines.zh: 老太婆的骨头，经不起这一下。
lines.en: An old woman's bones can't take that.

lines.zh: 我的水晶球可没碎。
lines.en: My crystal ball is intact.

lines.zh: 这包糖，够换一句实话。
lines.en: This packet of sugar buys one honest sentence.

lines.zh: 我不看重钱，但也不嫌多。
lines.en: I don't prize money, but I won't refuse it.

lines.zh: 你把糕点摆正，别堆着。
lines.en: Arrange the cakes properly. Don't pile them.

lines.zh: 新茶？我闻闻就知道年份。
lines.en: New tea? I can smell the year.

lines.zh: 你想用这个换什么？说清楚。
lines.en: What do you want for this? Say it plainly.

lines.zh: 我接过来，先不答应什么。
lines.en: I'll take it, without promising anything.

lines.zh: 东西放下，你的手收回去。
lines.en: Set it down and take your hand back.

lines.zh: 这点甜头，换不来大卦。
lines.en: That much sweetness won't buy a grand reading.

lines.zh: 我老了，见了甜的还是会心动。
lines.en: Old as I am, sweets still move me.

lines.zh: 你把香点上，比送什么都强。
lines.en: Light the incense. Better than any gift.

lines.zh: 别急，茶盘要翻了。
lines.en: Easy — the tray's tipping.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的袖子，线都松了。
lines.en: You caught my sleeve and the thread's loosened.

lines.zh: 这院子窄，两个人得错开走。
lines.en: The yard's narrow; two people must pass singly.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，球还在原处。
lines.en: I step back; the sphere stays put.

lines.zh: 你的手肘碰到我的念珠了。
lines.en: Your elbow caught my beads.

lines.zh: 撞我不打紧，别撞那盏灯。
lines.en: Bumping me's fine. Don't bump that lamp.

lines.zh: 我扶着门框，才没摔倒。
lines.en: I catch the doorframe and don't fall.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气扑了我一脸。
lines.en: Your warmth hits me full in the face.

lines.zh: 让开半步，我要过去。
lines.en: Half a step aside. I need to pass.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的卦纸弄散了。
lines.en: That scattered my divination papers.

lines.zh: 这问题，你该去问年轻人。
lines.en: That's a question for the young.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，只拿来算卦。
lines.en: This body is only for divining.

lines.zh: 茶还没喝完呢，别急。
lines.en: I haven't finished my tea. Don't rush.

lines.zh: 我算过自己的命，里头没这项。
lines.en: I've read my own fate. That isn't in it.

lines.zh: 你先把手从我肩上拿开。
lines.en: Take your hand off my shoulder first.

lines.zh: 这屋子不隔音，说话轻点。
lines.en: This house carries sound. Speak softly.

lines.zh: 我这把老骨头，经不起折腾。
lines.en: These old bones can't take much.

lines.zh: 换个话题，我还能多陪你坐会儿。
lines.en: Change the subject and I'll sit with you longer.

lines.zh: 你的姻缘我看不清，真的。
lines.en: Your prospects in love — I truly can't see them.

lines.zh: 卦象上写着：再等等。
lines.en: The reading says: wait longer.

lines.zh: 掉了一颗念珠，我找找。
lines.en: A bead fell. Let me find it.

lines.zh: 我拾起地上的卦钱，收好。
lines.en: I gather the coins from the floor.

lines.zh: 这张纸被踩脏了，可惜。
lines.en: This paper's been trodden dirty. A pity.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块炭，还能写字。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of charcoal; it'll still write.

lines.zh: 谁掉了把扇子？我拿着。
lines.en: Someone dropped a fan. I'll hold it.

lines.zh: 我把散开的签一根根归位。
lines.en: I put the scattered sticks back one by one.

lines.zh: 这个果子滚到桌下了。
lines.en: This fruit rolled under the table.

lines.zh: 我拾起一枚旧铜镜，照了照。
lines.en: I pick up an old bronze mirror and glance in it.

lines.zh: 地上的香灰，我扫成一堆。
lines.en: I sweep the ash into a little pile.

lines.zh: 我慢慢蹲下，膝盖响了一声。
lines.en: I crouch slowly; my knee clicks.

lines.zh: 我算到今晚有人闯院子。
lines.en: I read that someone would break into the yard tonight.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我的门槛。
lines.en: You've scuffed my threshold.

lines.zh: 我把球转向你，亮了。
lines.en: I turn the sphere toward you. It glows.

lines.zh: 这一卦，凶。
lines.en: This reading is ill-omened.

lines.zh: 外头那些影子，是你的吧。
lines.en: Those shadows outside — yours, I take it.

lines.zh: 我不喊人，我只要你退出去。
lines.en: I won't call for help. I just want you out.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我在卦里见过。
lines.en: I've seen your name in the reading.

lines.zh: 这院子有四道门，都关着。
lines.en: This yard has four doors, all shut.

lines.zh: 别动那口井，那是我的。
lines.en: Don't touch the well. That's mine.

lines.zh: 我看得见你，你的脚步太重了。
lines.en: I can see you. Your steps are too heavy.

lines.zh: 你绕到东厢，我也转向东。
lines.en: You circle to the east wing; I turn east.

lines.zh: 灯笼底下，你的影子拖得很长。
lines.en: Under the lantern your shadow stretches long.

lines.zh: 我把念珠掐在指间，数着你的步子。
lines.en: I count your paces between my beads.

lines.zh: 你不说话，我也知道你在想什么。
lines.en: You say nothing, and I still know your mind.

lines.zh: 这院子就这么大，你藏不到哪去。
lines.en: The yard is only so big. There's nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我的球面上映着你的背。
lines.en: Your back is reflected in my sphere.

lines.zh: 你在等天黑，我也在等。
lines.en: You're waiting for dark. So am I.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，灯焰就偏了。
lines.en: You lift a hand and the lamp flame bends.

lines.zh: 我把椅子转了半圈，正对你。
lines.en: I turn my chair a half circle to face you.

lines.zh: 别去碰那道门闩，我看见了。
lines.en: Don't reach for that bar. I saw.

lines.zh: 我用扇骨敲你的手腕。
lines.en: I rap your wrist with my fan's ribs.

lines.zh: 这一推，是警告。
lines.en: This shove is a warning.

lines.zh: 我把热茶泼向你的脸。
lines.en: I fling hot tea at your face.

lines.zh: 球滚过去，撞你的脚踝。
lines.en: The sphere rolls and strikes your ankle.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的袖口，扯了一下。
lines.en: I pinch your cuff and give it a yank.

lines.zh: 我抬手，掌风到你的胸前。
lines.en: I raise my palm; the force reaches your chest.

lines.zh: 这一下打在你的护腕上，很脆。
lines.en: That cracked against your bracer.

lines.zh: 我后退半步，又推了你一下。
lines.en: I step back and shove you again.

lines.zh: 香炉的盖子飞出去，砸中你。
lines.en: The brazier lid flies off and strikes you.

lines.zh: 你站不稳，是因为我算准了。
lines.en: You lost your footing because I planned it.

lines.zh: 这门宅是我在地球落脚的地方。
lines.en: This manor is where I've settled on Earth.

lines.zh: 灯笼一盏盏亮起来，我到了。
lines.en: The lanterns light one by one, and I arrive.

lines.zh: 我从神龛后转出来，慢慢坐下。
lines.en: I come out from behind the shrine and sit.

lines.zh: 有人在这屋子里摆好了椅子。
lines.en: Someone set a chair in this house for me.

lines.zh: 我带来了我的球，还有一壶茶。
lines.en: I brought my sphere and a pot of tea.

lines.zh: 地球的风比家乡软，我来了就不想走。
lines.en: Earth's wind is softer than home's. I'll stay.

lines.zh: 我把门槛擦干净，才迈进来。
lines.en: I wipe the threshold clean before stepping in.

lines.zh: 今天有客，我换了一件衣裳。
lines.en: A guest today, so I changed my robe.

lines.zh: 我从很远的世界来这里，只为见你。
lines.en: I came from a far world just to see you.

lines.zh: 香燃到一半的时候，我推门进来。
lines.en: At half a stick of incense, I pushed the door open.

lines.zh: 油灯翻了，火顺着我的裙角爬。
lines.en: The oil lamp tips and fire climbs my hem.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滑下去，半天没起来。
lines.en: I slide down the steps and lie there a while.

lines.zh: 井水灌进鼻子，我抓着井沿。
lines.en: Well water fills my nose; I clutch the rim.

lines.zh: 爆炸震落了梁上的灰，我伏在地上。
lines.en: The blast shakes dust off the beams; I drop low.

lines.zh: 一支飞镖扎进我的靠垫。
lines.en: A dart buries itself in my cushion.

lines.zh: 有股咒力缠住我的手腕。
lines.en: A cursing force coils around my wrist.

lines.zh: 两顿没吃，我端茶的手在抖。
lines.en: Two meals missed, and my teacup hand trembles.

lines.zh: 雷打在院里的树上，我耳鸣不止。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the yard tree; my ears won't stop ringing.

lines.zh: 地砖裂开，我直直地坠下去。
lines.en: The tiles split and I drop straight down.
